meta.description: Long-term rentals of apartments, houses and villas in Budva and on the Montenegrin coast: until the season or for a year. Send a request for a tailored search.

hero.lead: Apartments, houses and villas to rent until the season starts or for a full year. Short-term rentals are in development.
hero.image_alt: Budva: the Old Town and the bay with the dancer statue

seo.title: Long-term rentals on the coast
seo.p1: We handle long-term rentals: from autumn until the tourist season starts, or for a full year. Daily and short-term lets are not included in the catalogue.
seo.p2: Terms such as the deposit, utilities and pets are shown on the card when the owner has provided them; anything else we confirm before the viewing. We recommend signing a written tenancy agreement.

seo.title: Renting an apartment until the season or for a year
seo.p1: Rent is shown per month. If you rent until the season starts, confirm the move-out date in advance: in summer many owners switch to daily lets.
seo.p2: Tell us your budget, preferred area and move-in date — we will look for suitable options.

seo.title: Renting a house by the sea
seo.p1: This section lists houses and villas for long-term rent. Rent is shown per month; how utilities are paid is noted on the card when the owner has provided it.
seo.p2: Tell us your budget, the number of occupants and whether you have pets — so we can rule out unsuitable options straight away.
